Company.title: Company
Company.description: Represents a tenant company in the application.

status.description: The status of the company account.

ownerUID.description: The UID of the user who owns this company.

createdAt.description: The creation date of the company.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user within the FINSERV application, storing their basic profile information and role.

uid.description: The unique identifier for the user, matching the Firebase Auth UID.

name.description: The full name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

role.description: The user's role within their specific company.

companyId.description: The ID of the company this user belongs to.

Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: Represents a financed customer, storing their personal details, loan information, and agent assignment.

customerId.description: The unique identifier for the customer, matching the Firestore document ID.

companyId.description: The ID of the company this customer belongs to.

name.description: The full name of the customer.

phone.description: The phone number of the customer.

aadhar.description: The Aadhar number of the customer.

phoneModel.description: The phone model purchased by the customer.

totalPrice.description: The total price of the phone.

downPayment.description: The down payment made by the customer.

financedAmount.description: The amount financed for the customer.

interestAmount.description: The total interest amount for the loan.

totalPayable.description: The total amount payable (financed amount + interest).

duration.description: The duration of the loan in months.

startDate.description: The start date of the loan.

status.description: The status of the loan (active, completed, overdue).

payments.description: An array of payments made by the customer.

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description: Represents a payment made by a customer towards their loan. This is embedded within a Customer document.

date.description: The date the payment was made.

mode.description: The mode of payment (cash, UPI, etc.).

remainingBalance.description: The remaining balance after the payment.

Agent.title: Agent
Agent.description: Represents an agent user, embedded within customer documents.

name.description: The full name of the agent.

email.description: The email address of the agent.

expenseId.description: The unique identifier for the expense.

companyId.description: The ID of the company this expense belongs to.

date.description: The date the expense was incurred.

type.description: The category or type of the expense.

adminId.description: The UID of the admin who created the expense.

id.description: Unique identifier for the expense type.

name.description: The name of the expense type (e.g., 'Office Rent', 'Utilities').

createdAt.description: The creation date of the expense type.

WithdrawalRequest.title: Withdrawal Request
WithdrawalRequest.description: Represents a request by a company admin to withdraw funds.

companyId.description: The ID of the company requesting the withdrawal.

adminId.description: The UID of the admin making the request.

notes.description: Notes or reason for the withdrawal.

requestedAt.description: Timestamp of when the request was made.

processedAt.description: Timestamp of when the request was processed.

processedBy.description: UID of the super admin who processed the request.

companies.description: A top-level collection of all tenant companies.

users.description: A top-level collection of all application users (admins and agents).

customers.description: A top-level collection of all customers. Admins can access all customer data, while agents can only access customers they created.

expenses.description: A top-level collection of all business expenses. Only accessible by admins.

expenseTypes.description: A top-level collection for managing expense categories. Only accessible by admins.

withdrawalRequests.description: A top-level collection for managing fund withdrawal requests.
